source: Sum of the fourteen study-defined captured CO2 rates in supplementary Table S1; constant nominal flow in the original thirty labelled annual bins.
time: 8760-hour nominal model years labelled 2027–2056. Calendar placement is an engineering scenario, not an observed weather series.
storage: Aggregate rounded allocation outputs used explicitly as exogenous service proxies; not independent physical kr,t inputs. Injected mass is reported without asserting permanence.
static_proxies: ready_mean: each reservoir's total divided over its post-readiness bins
transport_model: Greedy deterministic batch shuttle; one loading berth and one receiving berth; cargo assigned at loading start and received at unloading end. Published port durations and cargo/heel volumes are used.
availability: Published8000 operating hours placed either in evenly staggered per-vessel windows or synchronised windows. Each active phase must finish within its window. Full nominal cycle must fit when loading begins. This conservative dispatch rule is a modelling choice, not proof of optimal scheduling.
fleet: Reference fleet from the published annual integer-capacity equation; fixed across the thirty bins. Added-vessel and minimum-added-fleet99%-of-continuous-reference controls are separate decisions.
inventory: Initial empty cargo system. Initial heel charged from captured source CO2. Export, import and marine stocks are balanced. Project-end stock receives no geological storage credit.
capture_policy: Capture curtailed at export-buffer capacity. No captured-source venting or leakage process is simulated; the model is a closed engineering inventory benchmark, not measured zero leakage.
included_emissions: active ship fuel-combustion CO2 using a declared MGO-factor transfer to an MDO fuel-rate scenario
optional_process_scenario: Published nameplate compressor power multiplied by8000h/year and a published generator SFOC. This is a costing-duty envelope, not a calculated BOG duty.
unquantified_components: wells, pressure management and water handling
missing_values: Not assigned zero. Complete net avoided GHG remains uncomputed.
allowance_identity: DeltaA = DeltaR_injected - DeltaG_ship_CO2 - DeltaU, conditional on compatible fossil-source counterfactual and retention reconciliation; the model reports the first two terms, so DeltaU must be less than the reported allowance for a positive full advantage.
optimality: No cost, climate or mixed-allocation optimum is claimed. Forward simulation and restricted added-fleet design controls are implemented.
